title: The Forest
description: The thick foliage restricts your view to a few yards in most places.
enemy-first-strike: Your foe gets the first strike!
round-result: Round {round}: you deal {damageToEnemy}, you take {damageToPlayer}. Your HP {playerHitPoint}, enemy HP {enemyHitPoint}.
victory: Victory! You gain {gold} gold and {experience} experience.
error.no-turn-left: You have no forest fights left today.
special.findgem.title: A Gem on the Path
special.findgem.description: `^Something glitters in the brush beside the path.
special.findgold.title: Gold on the Path
special.oldmanpretty.title: The Old Man with the Pretty Stick
special.oldmanpretty.description: `^An old man whacks you with a pretty stick, giggles and runs away.
special.oldmanugly.title: The Old Man with the Ugly Stick
special.oldmanugly.description: `^An old man whacks you with an ugly stick.
special.oldmanugly.outcome.stick-broke: You are uglier than his stick, and the stick loses a charm instead.
special.oldmanbet.title: The Old Man's Guessing Game
special.oldmanbet.description: `3An old man stops you as you wander the woods. "`!How would you like to play a little guessing game?`3"
special.oldmanbet.rule: Guess a number from {minimum} to {maximum} within {tryCount} tries and he pays {multiplier} times your wager. You carry {gold} gold.
special.oldmanbet.outcome.won: The old man howls and hands over {gold} gold.
special.oldmanbet.outcome.lost: The old man chuckles. "The number was {secret}." You pay what you owe.
special.oldmantown.title: The Old Man Bound for Town
special.oldmantown.description: `@An old man says he is lost and asks to be walked to the village. It costs one forest fight.
special.oldmantown.outcome.charm: You see him safely home and gain {charm} charm.
special.glowingstream.title: The Glowing Stream
special.glowingstream.description: `#Faintly glowing water babbles over round white stones. There is no telling whether it is safe to drink.
special.glowingstream.outcome.death: A clammy cold grips your heart and you collapse by the stream. The stones you saw were the skulls of earlier adventurers.
special.glowingstream.outcome.near-death: As your last breath leaves you, a fairy's dust lifts you back up. You keep only {hitPoint} hitpoints and lose {turn} forest fights.
special.glowingstream.outcome.full-heal-: You feel wonderful. You are fully healed and gain {turn} forest fights.
special.glowingstream.outcome.gem: Beneath a pebble you find {gem} gems.
special.glowingstream.outcome.turn: You feel light on your feet and gain {turn} forest fights.
special.fairy1.title: The Fairy
special.fairy1.description: `%A beautiful fairy meets you in the woods. "`^Will you give me a gem?`%"
special.fairy1.outcome.turn: She sprinkles her dust and you gain {turn} forest fights.
special.fairy1.outcome.no-gem: You have no gem to give, and she leaves in a huff.
special.fairy1.outcome.refused: The fairy darkens the sky in anger. You lose {turn} forest fights.
special.grassyfield.title: The Grassy Field
special.grassyfield.description: `#You come upon a broad field of grass bathed in sunlight.
special.grassyfield.rested: You rest a while and recover. Your {mount} costs you {turn} forest fights.
special.grassyfield.already-rested: You have rested enough. You sit and take in the sun.
special.riddles.title: The Riddling Gnome
special.riddles.description: `6A short gnome with leaves in his hair squats by a tree, giggling. "`@Answer my riddle and the boon is yours!`6"
special.riddles.outcome.gem-one: "Lizards and polywogs, you got it!" You receive {gem} gems.
special.riddles.outcome.gem-two: "Lizards and polywogs, you got it!" You receive {gem} gems.
special.riddles.outcome.turn: He does the hokey pokey and you feel ready for battle. You gain {turn} forest fights.
special.riddles.outcome.specialty-or-exp: He whacks you across the head. When you come to, you feel a little sharper.
special.riddles.outcome.gold-lost: You slip away under his mocking laughter, lighter by {gold} gold and {turn} forest fights. The answer was {answer}.
special.riddles.outcome.turn-lost: You cannot face another opponent today. You lose {turn} forest fights. The answer was {answer}.
special.riddles.outcome.charm-lost: His mockery costs you {charm} charm. The answer was {answer}.
special.audrey.title: Crazy Audrey
special.audrey.description: `5A woman with three baskets before her invites you to a game of kittens.
special.audrey.outcome.jackpot: "`%Golden? Golden?!`5" While she is lost in wonder you gain {turn} forest fights.
special.audrey.outcome.triple: All three matched. You gain {turn} forest fights.
special.audrey.outcome.pair: Two of them matched. You gain {turn} forest fights.
special.audrey.outcome.none: A kitten bolts and claws you on the way. You lose every forest fight you had left.
special.goldmine.title: The Abandoned Gold Mine
special.goldmine.description: `2You find the crumbling mouth of a mine shaft, a pick and cart still lying nearby.
special.goldmine.outcome.too-tired: You are far too tired to lift the pick.
special.goldmine.outcome.nothing: Hours of digging turn up nothing. You lose {turn} forest fights.
special.goldmine.outcome.gold: You find {gold} gold in the shaft. You lose {turn} forest fights.
special.goldmine.outcome.gem: You find {gem} gems in the shaft. You lose {turn} forest fights.
special.goldmine.outcome.treasure: A buried chest yields {gold} gold and {gem} gems. You lose {turn} forest fights.
special.goldmine.outcome.cave-in-survive: The shaft collapses but you scramble clear. The scare leaves you unfit to fight today.
special.goldmine.outcome.cave-in-death: Your greedy swing brings the shaft down. Buried under a ton of rock, you breathe your last. What you learned of mining is worth {experience} experience.
special.skillmaster.title: Foilwench
special.skillmaster.description: `^Deep in the woods you find an unfamiliar hut. A voice calls from inside. "`&One gem, and I will hone your craft.`^"
special.skillmaster.outcome.rank-gained: You hand over {gem} gems and your specialty advances a rank.
special.skillmaster.outcome.no-gem: You have no gem to offer, and she throws you out.
special.skillmaster.outcome.no-specialty: You have chosen no path, so there is nothing to learn.
special.skillmaster.outcome.refused: Foilwench loses interest and turns her back.
special.distress.title: A Plea for Rescue
special.distress.description: `3In the hand of a corpse with an arrow in its back you find a plea for rescue. Where will you go?
special.distress.outcome.rescue: You free the captive and are rewarded.
special.distress.outcome.troll: A lonely troll leaps from the chest.
special.distress.outcome.hag: The chamber holds a wrinkled old thing. You lose {charm} charm.
special.distress.outcome.fop: A foppish figure trips over his own robes, and you slip away.
special.distress.outcome.death: You are hopelessly outnumbered and fall beneath their blades.
special.distress.outcome.escape: You break free and flee. You lose {turn} forest fights and keep only {hitPoint} hitpoints.
special.distress.outcome.fined: You burst into the wrong house and are fined for damages. You lose all the gold you carried.
special.necromancer.title: The Old Necromancer
special.necromancer.description: `@An old man wreathed in blue mist beckons you closer. Approaching costs one forest fight.
special.necromancer.outcome.death: A black wand tears your spirit from your body. You lose all the gold you carried.
special.necromancer.outcome.drained: The molten pain passes. Your maximum hitpoints drop by {experience} and you keep only {hitPoint}.
special.necromancer.outcome.gem-request: "`#A gem for me own self, yes?`@"
special.necromancer.outcome.scared-off: A village guard crashes through the brush and the old man flees.
special.necromancer.outcome.favor: He promises to put in a word with Ramius and leaves you {favor} favor.
special.necromancer.outcome.gem-stolen: He snatches the gem and bolts into the forest.
special.necromancer.outcome.gem-kept: Unwilling to part with your gems, you turn back.
special.necromancer.outcome.no-gem: You have no gem, and his face darkens. You leave in haste.
special.darkhorse.title: The Dark Horse Tavern
special.darkhorse.description: `7The mist clears to reveal a log building with smoke trailing from its chimney. The sign reads "Dark Horse Tavern."
special.darkhorse.dice.title: Dice
special.darkhorse.dice.rule: Roll up to three times; beat the old man and you take your wager. Wager:
special.darkhorse.dice.progress: Roll {count} shows {roll}. Your wager is {bet} gold.
special.darkhorse.dice.outcome.won: You rolled {playerRoll}, he rolled {oldManRoll}. You win {gold} gold.
special.darkhorse.dice.outcome.lost: You rolled {playerRoll}, he rolled {oldManRoll}. You lose {gold} gold.
special.darkhorse.dice.outcome.draw: You rolled {playerRoll}, he rolled {oldManRoll}. A tie.
special.darkhorse.stone.title: Stones
special.darkhorse.stone.rule: Two stones are drawn from six red and ten blue. Pick a side and a wager:
special.darkhorse.stone.progress: Drawn: {drawn}. You {playerScore}, he {oldManScore}. The pouch holds {red} red and {blue} blue. Your wager is {bet} gold.
special.darkhorse.stone.outcome.won: You win {playerScore} to {oldManScore} and take {gold} gold.
special.darkhorse.stone.outcome.lost: You lose {playerScore} to {oldManScore} and forfeit {gold} gold.
special.darkhorse.enemy.title: Word on Your Enemies
special.darkhorse.enemy.rule: The barkeep asks 100 gold a head. Name:
special.darkhorse.enemy.empty: He knows no one by that name.
special.darkhorse.enemy.column.name: Name
special.darkhorse.enemy.result: {name}: level {level}, max hitpoints {hitPoint}, gold {gold}, weapon {weapon}, armor {armor}, attack {attack}, defense {defence}.
